notes: KNOWN FAILING: the #1985 live recording exposed two daemon identity defects while the two DSH processes shared one cwd. Session 2 produced a premature working-to-ready transition before its durable turn/end, then produced a second working-to-ready arc when the turn actually ended. At teardown, session 2's transcript_removed event carried session 1's transcript path. The expected phases remain the correct target: two arcs on session 1, one arc on session 2, distinct positive PIDs, and no identity crossover. The no-later-working guard makes the extra session-2 arc fail; the phase DSL cannot express cwd equality or transcript-path identity, so the manual recording audit is also load-bearing. Spec ordering was corrected from PID-before-working to the live working-before-PID sequence per #1985, 'feat(onboard): record deepseek-harness/multiple-sessions-same-cwd (10/11)'.
